comment: Overtime replacements for EA-branded connection texts and the news tile (stringid -> text). Applied by tools/text_pack.py to the user's own game.

strings.TXT_UNABLE_TO_LOGIN:
Unable to connect to the Overtime community server at this time. To play online, check that your network connection is working, that you are signed in to ShadNet in shadPS4 and that the game was started with the Overtime patch, or try again later.
Overtime community servers are not affiliated with EA.
strings.TXT_ORIGIN_UNABLE_TO_CONNECT: Unable to connect to the Overtime account server at this time. Please try again later.
strings.TXT_LOGIN_INVALID_USER: To connect to the Overtime server you must be signed in to ShadNet in shadPS4.
strings.OSDK_LOST_CON_TO_EA: You have lost your connection to the Overtime server. Please check your network connection. You will be unable to access any online features until you sign in again.
strings.OSDK_LOST_CON_TO_EA_AVATAR: You have lost your connection to ShadNet and thus your connection to the Overtime server. Please check your network connection. You will be unable to access any online features until you sign in to ShadNet and the Overtime server again.
strings.TXT_DISCONNECTED: You have lost your connection to ShadNet and thus your connection to the Overtime server. Please check your network connection. You will be unable to access any online features until you sign in to ShadNet and the Overtime server again.
strings.TXT_DISCONNECTED_AVATAR: You have lost your connection to ShadNet and thus your connection to the Overtime server. Please check your network connection. You will be unable to access any online features until you sign in to ShadNet and the Overtime server again.
strings.OSDK_EA_SIGNIN_REQUIRED_FOR_INVITE: You must be connected to the Overtime server to use online features. Please sign in and try again.
